en: Vintage sepia postcard showing a central square with broad terraced steps, a stone balustrade and formal gardens. On the left stands an older church-like building; in the centre background is a statue on a pedestal, with buses and people around. On the right is an ornate late‑19th‑century building with arcaded ground floor, balcony and decorative facade. At the bottom of the image is a printed Hungarian caption. The reverse side shows handwritten Hungarian text, a printed publisher line, and a Hungarian stamp from Magyar Posta.
